name: High-speed rail (game corridors)
source: Operational corridor selection; detailed OSM track geometry / OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, September 2026
warning: Game definition: Vienna (Hbf and Westbf) via St. Poelten, Linz Hbf and Wels to Attnang-Puchheim; Graz-Klagenfurt Koralmbahn; Meidling-Wiener Neustadt Pottendorfer Linie. Includes slower station approaches, connecting sections and mapped fast bypasses. Excludes Attnang-Salzburg, Marchegger Ostbahn (200 km/h status not verified), unfinished projects and the out-of-game Tirol network. Not a per-segment speed classification. Check and agree this corridor definition before applying.
